# PRD writer (Mohit Aggarwal)

Writes a full product requirements document from a feature idea.

- Source: https://github.com/mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills/main/skills/prd-template/SKILL.md
- Author: Mohit Aggarwal
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/prd-writer-mohit-aggarwal-2c12464b

Produces a PRD with overview, context, user stories, functional requirements, design notes, technical considerations, an implementation plan and open questions. It includes writing guidelines, a 40-point scoring rubric, quality checks and anti-patterns, and can draw on a shared project knowledge folder if one exists. Templates and reference material are bundled.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a PRD for a customer support dashboard that merges email and chat"
- "Turn these meeting notes into a PRD"
- "Score this existing PRD against the rubric and suggest fixes"

**Source:** [mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills](https://github.com/mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills/tree/HEAD/skills/prd-template) · MIT · by Mohit Aggarwal
